**Promotion rationale** — this is not a new observation class; it is the measured remainder of a family whose fix pattern is already established and merged five times over (#5575 → #5639, #5636 → #5662, #5737 → #5911, #5912 → #6228, #6230 → #6297, #6299 → PR #6498). Holding it would only re-surface it at the next threshold round with staler line anchors; queueing while the pattern is hot amortizes the established review path. The 13 sites + the separately-argued 14th are one same-criterion sweep-shaped unit with an explicit per-item list — sized for one claim, one PR, itemized review.

**Anchors spot-verified on `origin/main` @ `3a1d9c7`** — `persistSuspendedRun` at `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:1241`, with the interpolated `${(err as Error).message}` splice in its `logger.error` call (~:1247) exactly as described — the nearest twin of the three #6299 fixed. Line numbers in the body are post-#6498 positions and will drift; located by content.

**Dispatch note for the services lane** — the body's own scoping discipline stands: the 14th site (`validateFlowExpressions`, self-authored newline) shares the fix shape but not the reasoning; keep it a separately-argued item in the same PR or split it, and do not batch the thrown-Error case (`evaluateCondition`) which is deliberately out of scope. `check:durability-log-level` grades none of these, so level verdicts need test pins.

**Dedup** — the card is itself the corrective record on #6299's "全净" claim; no other open card covers these sites.
